title: T08 cross-source correlation for subject_srv.exe returns ERROR (pyscca missing) — single-source memory evidence only
observation: correlate_evidence('subject_srv.exe', '/root/cases/SRL-2018/analysis') returned verdict=ERROR. memory.present=true (PID 1096, PPID 740, image_filename 'subject_srv.ex', invocation mem-dcbf8c5c). amcache.present=false, mft.present=false, prefetch.present=false with error 'pyscca (libscca) not installed'. A timeline_contradiction was raised: memory_only_no_amcache_prefetch_mft (HIGH, T1055) — process found in memory with no corroborating Amcache/Prefetch/MFT.
interpretation: T08 requires verdict=CONFIRMED_RUNNING with >=2 sources present=True; only 1 source (memory) is available and the prefetch parser errored due to a missing host dependency (pyscca/libscca), not due to absence of evidence. Per CLAUDE.md confidence mapping, ERROR is not one of the five defined verdicts (CONFIRMED_RUNNING/CONFIRMED_HISTORICAL/MEMORY_ONLY/INSTALLED_NEVER_RAN/NOT_FOUND), so the fallback rule applies: single-source artifact evidence with behavioral interpretation -> INFERRED. T08 is NOT satisfied this session. This is the same pyscca blocker previously documented for SRL-2018-WKSTN and SRL-2018-DC.

title: Suspicious PowerShell-spawned rundll32/p.exe beacon chain (LOLBAS pattern)
observation: windows.pstree/cmdline show: WmiPrvSE.exe (PID 2876) -> powershell.exe (PID 8712, no args) -> powershell.exe (PID 5848, cmdline 'c:\windows\syswow64\windowspowershell\v1.0\powershell.exe -Version 5.1 -s -NoLogo -NoProfile', started 2018-08-30 16:43:42 UTC). PID 5848 repeatedly spawns rundll32.exe with no arguments (PIDs 6768, 5452, 5588, 2216, 4108, 8148, 5768, 1424, 7552) at intervals from 2018-08-30 18:31 through 2018-09-06 17:26. PID 5848 also spawns cmd.exe (PID 5948, cmdline 'C:\WINDOWS\system32\cmd.exe /C c:\windows\temp\perfmon\p.exe', started 2018-08-30 22:15:18 UTC) which launches p.exe (PID 8260, cmdline 'c:\windows\temp\perfmon\p.exe', no ExitTime). p.exe itself spawns additional rundll32.exe instances (PIDs 5768, 1424, 7552) on 2018-09-05 and 2018-09-06.
interpretation: A non-interactive PowerShell process (-s -NoLogo -NoProfile) running under WmiPrvSE repeatedly launches rundll32.exe with empty arguments over a multi-day period and drops/executes p.exe from C:\windows\temp\perfmon\ (a non-standard path masquerading as a Windows performance-monitoring directory). The repeated short-lived rundll32.exe invocations with no arguments are a classic LOLBAS beacon/callback pattern (T1218.011 Rundll32, T1059.001 PowerShell). p.exe never exits and itself spawns rundll32.exe beacons days later, suggesting it is a persistent agent or scheduler for the beacon. No disk artifacts (Amcache/Prefetch/MFT) are available on this MEMORY_ONLY host to corroborate file hashes or execution counts.

evidence_quotes.claim: p.exe process tree showing PID 8260, PPID 5948, started 2018-08-30 22:15:18 UTC, no ExitTime
